what: Admission null + de-atomization for the atomicity diagnostic A_l(t) at t=0.005 (l=1), executed per the pre-registered protocol in tools/spectral-defocus/defocus.py run_admit_null()

protocol.admission: A_1(0.005) on n curveball draws (fixed row+column margins, trades=20*n_rows) -> z of real A_1; pre-registered reading: |z|<3 marginal-dominated (diagnostic only), |z|>=3 admissible coordinate, degenerate null inadmissible
protocol.de_atomization: value-level Nadaraya-Watson vMF smoothing of targets, positions unchanged; bar: some kappa achieves A_1_smoothed <= 0.5*A_1_real

initial_n10.note: z inflated by small-n sd underestimate

verdicts.admission: NEGATIVE: A_1 is marginal-dominated (z=+1.59/+1.27 at n=50, two seeds; the curveball null itself is atomic, mean A_1 ~ 0.86). Valid atomicity DIAGNOSTIC; NOT admissible as a corpus-specific map coordinate under the membership condition.
verdicts.de_atomization: NEGATIVE: halving bar unreachable. Smoothed A_1 is monotone decreasing in 1/kappa but even kappa=2 (~46 deg kernel, destroys essentially all angular structure) reaches only 0.492 vs bar 0.473. Cause: the all-ones atom (795 identical rows, ~35% of mass) is a point mass no kernel can spread.
verdicts.ci_encoding: lean-check.yml verify-tools runs --admit-null --n-null 50; the gate asserts the recorded negative REPRODUCES (non-degenerate null AND |z|<3 AND halving unmet). Drift in either direction fails CI.
